scripts.text: Hey, I remember you! I already told you that you may only complete this quest once.
scripts.translation: 嘿，我記得你！我已經告訴過你，這個任務只能完成一次。

scripts.text: Greeting, lad. I found a really nifty item while I was picking mushrooms near Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 你好啊，年輕人。我在葛拉斯特海姆附近採蘑菇時，發現了一件很不錯的物品。

scripts.text: I have never seen an item like this before. I am told it can be placed inside any accessory with a slot available.
scripts.translation: 我從沒見過這樣的物品。據說它可以鑲嵌在任何有插槽的飾品上。

scripts.text: If you're interested in this item, I'll tell you what you need for me to make you one of your own. I can only give one of these to each player, so once you finish this quest, you may not do it again.
scripts.translation: 如果你對這件物品感興趣，我可以告訴你需要提供什麼材料，我才能為你製作一件。每位玩家只能得到一件，所以完成這個任務後就不能再做一次了。

scripts.text: Nah, I don't care about it
I believe the item is called a ^FF0000Berzebub Card^000000. It makes you cast spells really fast!
scripts.translation: 我想這件物品叫作^FF0000貝雷傑卡片^000000。它能讓你施法快上許多！

scripts.text: I need all of the following items:
You lie! Get out of here and get those items, you sorry excuse for a rock star.
scripts.translation: 你騙人！快滾去把那些東西找齊，你這不配當搖滾明星的傢伙。

scripts.text: Congratulations! You have all the items. Here is your ^FF0000Berzebub Card^000000, as promised.
scripts.translation: 恭喜！你已經集齊了所有物品。按約定，這是你的^FF0000貝雷傑卡片^000000。

scripts.text: Such a great item I have right here...
scripts.translation: 我這裡正好有件好東西...
